question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Piece of cake
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Piece of cake" **refers to something that is very easy or simple to achieve or accomplish.(बहुत आसान)
 
• **Something which is very simple -** It refers to a task or situation that is easy to handle or achieve.(बहुत सरल).

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: *'Something which is very simple'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Extremely difficult - ** It refers to a task or situation that is very hard to handle or overcome.(अत्यंत कठिन).
 
• **Intuition for something dangerous - **This refers to a feeling or sense that something harmful or unpleasant is going to happen.(किसी खतरनाक चीज के लिए सहज बोध).
 
• **Invitation for birthday - **This refers to a formal or polite request to attend someone's birthday.(जन्मदिन के लिए निमंत्रण).
